usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all SDN routing controllers (BGP, EVPN, IS-IS, Faucet) configured in the cluster. Pass 'pending: true' to preview staged changes that have not yet been applied via 'apply', or 'running: true' to see only what is currently active on the data plane. Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' on each controller path — callers without either privilege on a controller will simply not see that entry in the response.

examples.summary: List only EVPN controllers with pending (unapplied) changes visible

tips: A 'state' field of 'changed' or 'new' on a returned controller means the config has been saved but not yet applied — run the SDN apply operation to push it to the data plane.
Omitting both 'pending' and 'running' returns the stored config; it may differ from what is actually running if changes were made but not applied.
The 'digest' field on each controller can be used as an optimistic-lock value when updating or deleting a specific controller.
Filter by 'type' to scope results when you only care about, e.g., BGP controllers in a mixed SDN deployment.
